name: Big Eau Pleine County Park, West Campground
waterfront_evidence: Split 2026-11-21, this entry = the West campground (sites 001-046). Site coordinates from the county reservation engine (https://www.parks.marathoncounty.gov/wausau-marathon/reservation/campgrounds/7f798887-a407-4a93-952a-98e6d5cd959a, read 2026-11-21) plotted on Esri World_Imagery read 2026-11-21 at 44.7433,-89.8533 (140 m half-width), 44.74332,-89.8516 (230 m) and 44.7420,-89.8460 (750 m), all rendered. The engine's 'lakeside' sites 030, 033, 034, 036 and 041-046 (030-040 'sunny with a view of the flowage', 041-046 'partially shaded with a view of the flowage') sit under continuous canopy about 45-55 m back from the tree line on the Big Eau Pleine Reservoir, and the county West Unit map (Cedar PDF, 'Updated September 2026', read 2026-11-21) runs a walking trail between them and the shore. No site on open ground within ~50 m of the water -> lakeview (unchanged). Open-Meteo DEM 346 m at the shore points vs 370 m at the pin (a canopy surface model, not a bluff). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Marathon County reservation engine, West Campground facility (https://www.parks.marathoncounty.gov/wausau-marathon/reservation/campgrounds/7f798887-a407-4a93-952a-98e6d5cd959a, read 2026-11-21): 'The West Campground at Big Eau Pleine Park features 46 electric campsites, with many sites positioned to take advantage of views of the Big Eau Pleine Reservoir.'; per-site data: gravel pads 40-60 ft (only 035 at 40 ft), 43 reservable electric sites plus accessible site 029, host site 015, administrative site 017; reservable up to 365 days ahead. A real county drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits. Own spur road off Eau Pleine Park Rd, separate from the South campground's (Esri street map + county unit maps, read 2026-11-21).
note: Marathon County park on a wooded peninsula in the Big Eau Pleine Reservoir west of Mosinee. The West campground is four wooded loops beside the boat landing, swimming beach, playground and disc golf course, with a lakeshore walking trail below the flowage-view sites; a group site sits on the paved lot to the south. The park's South campground, about 1.4 km away on its own road, has its own entry. Firewood is sold near the South picnic area. --Claude
curation_note: Split 2026-11-21 (audit/verify/kit/wi/splits/NOTES_3535.md): this id kept the West campground (001-046); the South campground (047-106, 1.40 km centroid to centroid, own spur road and own booking facility) became a new entry. Pin unchanged (u-06 had moved it 720 m onto the West loops 2026-11-20; it is 2 m from the public-site centroid). Sites 102 -> 44, fees narrowed to West's rates, hookups.water false added. --Claude

hookups.note: Every public site has electric; the campsite amperage is not posted (the group site’s pedestals offer 20/30 A and 20/30/50 A).

sites.note: Sites 001-046 less host site 015 and administrative site 017; accessible site 029 is booked by phone. A Group site (tents on turf, rigs on the paved lot) books separately.

facilities.note: Water from pressurized-well pumps in the campground; the park dump station is open 8 am - 8 pm ($8).

season.note: October is first-come only: reservations cover May 1 - September 30.

booking.note: Online reservations close 3 days before arrival. An unreserved site may be self-registered on site for up to 3 nights (cash or check); in October every site is first-come. Check-in 3 pm.

fees.note: 2026: $30 for the lakeview electric sites, $28 for the other electric sites. The online engine quotes $30.33 a night for residents and $32.23 for non-residents. Cancelling costs $10.
